title: Paul McCartney live: CenturyLink Center, Bossier City | 2017
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the CenturyLink Center in Bossier City, Louisiana, USA, on 15 July 2017.

Legends keeping good company tonight in the Shreveport/Bossier City area… #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/ebQ6VjNUaa

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) July 15, 2017

It was the 48th show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between April 2016 and December 2017. This concert was seen by 13,037 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

TCB in Bossier City with @jburtonmusic #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/WO9Y8iGosI

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) July 16, 2017
